storage_preflight.purpose: Prevent loss of Copilot private session persistence after long media-processing runs.

artifact_isolation.method: Each run mounts a newly created empty temporary directory at /calibration and copies the trajectory and solution to the requested host path only after container exit.

ablation_isolation.method: Every degraded-input run masks the image's /baked directory with a 1 MB tmpfs and mounts only the intended degraded media and permitted non-media materials.

network_isolation.host_firewall: INPUT accepts only the run's random allowlist-proxy port on its dedicated bridge and drops every other bridge-to-host connection.
network_isolation.github_auth_phase: api.github.com is allowed only before the first Copilot API connection; that first model connection permanently seals GitHub access for the run.
network_isolation.note: api.github.com is required by Copilot CLI for /copilot_internal/user token validation, but is revoked before the model can request tools. Raw tool calls and proxy logs are retained for every run.
